I sent 500 ringless voicemails to local business owners live and tried to sell them AI voice agents in real time. No tricks, no edits, just me using Sly Broadcast, scraping leads with Outscraper, and watching the callbacks come in on my Google Voice number. We talk through what kind of response rates you can expect, how to handle the calls, and why this “reverse cold calling” approach actually works. Then I show step by step how to build an AI voice agent inside GoHighLevel using ChatGPT and a simple knowledge base so you can see how fast this can actually be set up and sold.

Enjoy!
